text: Ko woni, ɓe jogiti gaanin Alla reweteeɗi, maakan an Nulaaɗo- ɓee sirkooɓe: "Addee hujja mon on e hanndugol rewugol ɗi, awa ndee Deftere jippinaa- nde e am, e Defte jippinaaɗe ɗen e Nulaaɓe ɓen on maraa hujja e nder majje, ko woni, ɓurɓe ɓen e sirkooɓe ɓen ɓe tuugutaako si wanaa e majjere e ñemmbugol, hara kamɓe ko ɓe ɗurniiɓe e jaɓugol Goonga kan.
